title: Incremental async exact token repair
description: Post-smart-compact turns accumulate heuristic raw/smooth/chunk-smooth counts during normal use because async maintenance skips whole-thread exact repair without an incremental replacement. Implement async suffix/incremental exact counting for newly closed turns and affected chunks; keep smart compact prepare as full catch-up; allow strict smart compact after settled normal use.
acceptance_criteria: Service tests demonstrate: (1) async maintenance exact-counts affected/new closed raw turn token metadata; (2) async maintenance exact-counts/repairs smooth materialized token metadata after smoothing; (3) affected chunk token metadata is exact/trusted when chunk artifacts are updated; (4) thread tokenCounting status clears when the only issues were the repaired incremental token counts; (5) smart-compact readiness/service path no longer reports token-count repair blocker after async maintenance has settled. No E2E required for this bead unless service boundary cannot prove the behavior.
notes:
Tech-lead implementation guidance: keep this focused. The async thread-view maintenance lane should pay incremental exact token-readiness debt for newly affected turns/chunks/artifacts, so strict smart compact works after normal settled use. Prefer using/refactoring existing async maintenance and token-count repair services rather than inventing a parallel repair system. Future standalone maintain/repair command is tracked separately as pi-long-horizon-2cz.
Started implementation. Inspecting async maintenance and token-count repair services to add incremental exact counting for newly closed turns/chunks without new commands or parallel repair system.
Process note: avoid chaining bead status updates with broad repo searches; keep tool-output commands narrow or redirect output to avoid noisy transcripts. Implementation finding: maintainAsyncThread already has exact repair path and tests, but PI background maintenance currently passes exactTokenCountRepairEnabled:false, leaving post-compact async maintenance repair-needed.
Implemented: PI background maintenance now allows maintainAsyncThread exact-token repair instead of passing exactTokenCountRepairEnabled:false. Added production turn_end test coverage with a deterministic exact counter asserting closed turns receive provider_input_count/exact raw and smooth metadata and tokenCounting status is ready. Validation: npm run typecheck; node --import tsx --test tests/context-steward/capture-service.test.ts --test-name-pattern 'production turn_end handler closes'; node --import tsx --test tests/thread/async-thread-run-service.test.ts --test-name-pattern 'normal async maintenance'.
QA complete. Implementation is intentionally small: production PI turn_end async maintenance no longer disables exact token-count repair, so the existing maintainAsyncThread repair path can exact-count newly affected artifacts and clear tokenCounting when settled. During review, full service validation exposed lower-band tests that were stale relative to providerMetadata provenance now persisted on semantic lower-band artifacts. We treated that as repo drift from the shared workstream, not an unrelated excuse: updated tests to assert providerMetadata and restored repo green. Also raised lower-band compression input cap from 4,000 to 8,500 estimated tokens after dogfood showed a legitimate process-lesson chunk slightly exceeding the old cap. Validation: root typecheck passed; service verify passed with 492 tests; package lh-context typecheck/test/build passed; e2e tests passed. Note: prior verify-all attempt used too-small 240s timeout; use 600s for full verify-all.

title: Investigate capture append STORE_UNAVAILABLE failures
description: A PI extension capture append failed during active dogfood: CAPTURE_APPEND_FAILED: Failed to append response from agent actor at 2026-05-20T15:50:29.204Z; STORE_UNAVAILABLE: thread mutation failed. This appeared while editing/running tests and while background maintenance was active. Fresh evidence: current thread thread_df67cbe0-2c0d-4c6e-90fa-570b04cd9bcc is otherwise still advancing (sourceRevision/highWatermark 1357 as of 2026-05-20T15:53:38Z); no lingering .thread-mutation-locks files were found; timing log around incident shows several captureEvent calls taking ~1.5-3.8s and repairMissingArtifacts at 15:51:11 ending result=updateChunkFailed after updateChunkMs=2674. Need determine whether append failure is transient stale revision/lock contention, mutation coordinator behavior, file-store availability, or missing retry/backoff path. Related: standalone repair command should help detect/fix gaps, but capture append reliability deserves its own investigation.
acceptance_criteria: Reproduce or classify CAPTURE_APPEND_FAILED/STORE_UNAVAILABLE path with evidence; identify whether canonical message gap can occur and how to detect it; add service tests around concurrent capture vs async maintenance mutation if applicable; add retry/backoff or serialization fix if needed; ensure failures are surfaced with enough diagnostic context; document whether repair-thread command should detect/repair capture gaps.

title: Add standalone thread maintenance/repair command
description: Add a standalone operation that runs prepare-like thread maintenance/repair without generating or reloading a smart-compact PI session. It should inspect the current canonical thread and async artifacts, repair/derive/count missing or stale state where possible, and produce a useful report of what was already ready, what was fixed, what failed, and where. This separates 'clean up memory state' from 'compact/reload session'. Intended as a fast follow to incremental async exact token repair and should reuse the same repair pipeline/services.
acceptance_criteria: Command/SDK operation exists for maintain/repair without compact/reload; reports repaired/skipped/failed items by turn/chunk/artifact; does not write generated PI session; reuses repair pipeline from incremental async repair where practical; after success, strict smart compact should not need prepare for the repaired state.

title: Add lh-context compound post-compact report
description: Add a compound report command, likely lhx report post-compact --root . and --json. Combine summary, generated session token count/provenance, degraded/repair-needed status, token rollups, band layout, and warning/mismatch diagnostics. Goal: one standard report after smart compact, no ad hoc bash or Node glue.

title: Improve smart compact error reporting
description: Current failures collapse into generic messages like blocked before generated output. Preserve phase, scope, turn/chunk id when relevant, status/error code, and sanitized provider error where safe.

title: Prevent smart compact/background stderr UI pollution
description: Raw service warnings can bleed into the PI conversation surface via stderr, visually corrupting assistant/user rendering. Route background warnings to structured logs/debug files, command reports, or PI UI notifications/status surfaces; background maintenance must not interleave raw warning text into chat.

title: Smart compact progress feedback
description: Smart compact can sit silent for 30-60s+ during prepare/generate/reload. Add command-start/status feedback, clear status in finally, and later phase updates for prepare, token repair, projection, final count, write/reload.

title: Make long-horizon tooling globally available
description: Make lhx/lh-context and related tools available from any directory where a long-horizon agent may launch. Resolve global install/linking, project root discovery, .context-steward discovery, env/config, and consistent access from PI/other CLI/service harnesses.

title: Decide lh-context package/repo publish wiring
description: packages/lh-context exists as one package exposing SDK + CLI. Decide root workspace wiring, root scripts, package name/versioning, npm publish path, and PI extension integration.

title: Maintain focused E2E coverage for smart compact/lower-band
description: Keep high-signal E2E tests for failures that matter: async thread view reaches OpenAI token counting, detailed/brief inference artifacts are generated/persisted, generated rollout includes expected source types. Avoid broad noisy E2E.

title: Ensure lower-band artifact provenance
description: Detailed/brief lower-band artifacts should carry provider provenance so deterministic fallback cannot satisfy inference-generated artifact tests. Preserve provider/model/prompt version/reasoning/usage where available and prevent deterministic ready fallback for semantic artifacts.

title: Support manual smooth/projection curation with provenance
description: We manually edited derived smooth state/projection to remove accidental bulk from prompt-visible memory while preserving canonical source. Add supported operations for manual smooth override, lower-band/chunk invalidation, optional projection edit helper, and audit/provenance.

title: Add lh-context turn/chunk/readiness inspection commands
description: Next SDK/CLI slice should add turns, turn <index|id>, chunks, chunk <id>, and readiness. Readiness should answer whether strict compact is likely OK or prepare should be used.

title: Add live-tail/current-active-context accounting
description: Inspection should distinguish last compact generated bands, live turns appended after reload, current active full-fidelity/live region, and hypothetical next compact selection. This was a repeated confusion source.

title: Explore LLM/Keeper Wiki durable knowledge layer
description: Explore a Karpathy-style LLM wiki as an additional long-horizon memory layer. Wiki contains raw/source docs plus derived LLM-maintained pages; spec packs can enter as authoritative raw sources; keeper agent ingests, updates index/log, answers questions, reconciles/lints, and maintains durable synthesized project understanding.

title: Fold Liminal Spec process notes into skills/tools
description: Notes were updated on sharding, enrichment, implementation orchestration, boundary issues, artifact-vs-git truth, and production/runtime path proof. Fold lessons into actual skills and lbuild-impl CLI.

title: Refine prompt-visible tool-result truncation policy
description: Current prompt-visible tool-result truncation works as a blunt pressure valve. Refine with head+tail retention, error tail/stack preservation, per-tool policies, command metadata, and important-output hints.

title: Define projection/session edit hygiene
description: Generated thread-view files may be manually edited during dogfood. Define canonical vs projection edits, reload behavior, backups before edits, and audit notes for manual curation.

title: Add snapshot/restore workflow
description: .thread-snapshots stores heavyweight snapshots and catalog metadata. Add command support for create snapshot, capture counts/metadata, catalog entry, and eventually restore instructions or restore operation.

title: Format surfaced warnings cleanly
description: If lower-band/smart-compact warnings are intentionally surfaced, format them cleanly with newline separation/prefixes, command/report framing, and no long unstructured terminal lines.

title: Clarify band percentage terminology
description: Band percentages are allocation hints, not guarantees. Consider docs/UI terminology such as bandShape, bandWeights, or allocationHints.
